description: This file defines the class MqttCommandEndpointConfiguration, which extends CommandEndpointConfiguration, and provides configuration properties and methods specific to MQTT command endpoint testing scenarios, including topic filtering and validation.

classes.name: MqttCommandEndpointConfiguration
classes.description: A configuration class for MQTT command endpoints used in test scenarios, including topic filter generation and validation methods.

methods.name: <init>
methods.description: Constructor initializing configuration with subscriber role and legacy endpoint usage flags.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the configuration, including subscriber role, endpoints, and topic filter.

methods.name: getCommandTopicFilter
methods.description: Generates the MQTT topic filter string for subscribing to commands based on role, legacy topic filter preference, and device ID.

methods.name: getResponseTopic
methods.description: Constructs the response topic string for device responses, including request ID and status.

methods.name: assertCommandPublishTopicStructure
methods.description: Validates the structure of a command publish topic against expected values, including endpoint, device ID, request ID, and command name.
